eta=epsilon*beta and |Ui|>=beta*n transfer both support<=eta*n and a<=eta*n to the required epsilon*|Ui| budgets. delta=min(eta,min(alpha/3840,eta*alpha/720)) is positive and simultaneously supplies the weighted density, support and core error inequalities.

n0 dominates 1, ceil(20/eta), ceil(120/alpha), and ceil(m0/beta). The half-reserve lemma uses alpha*n/30<=r and n>=120/alpha to prove (alpha/120)*|Ui|<=floor(r/2), hence h-floor(r/2)<=floor(h-(alpha/120)*|Ui|). r<=h justifies the final exact identity h-(h-r/2)=r/2.
The packing theorem uses alpha/30 and gamma=alpha/120. Since |Ui|<=n and alpha*n/30<=r<=h, its degree density holds. tau<=alpha/240 equals the required tau<=(alpha/30)/8.

The original h-color palette is retained throughout grouping and exceptional insertion. Positive L and |Z|<=2 give max(3L,|Z|+1)=3L. The constructed full external classes have support<=6L+4; the uniform numerical budget converts this to eta*n.

An injective protected f:Fin(r/2)->Fin h has a complement indexed injectively and exhaustively by Fin(h-r/2). Pairwise copy disjointness and exact prescriptions split the external union into nonprotected classes and original prescribed reserve classes.

Each selected class is completed only with copies internal to U0 or U1. Constant original labels on each shore and shore/exceptions disjointness make those internal pools disjoint from the exterior. The exact external remainder therefore equals the reserve union on the actual first-residual copy type, with a second-residual survivingCopies equality and exact Subtype.val image.

The prefix consists of exactly h-r/2 pairwise disjoint actual perfect matchings, avoids every protected reserve copy, and leaves an r/2-regular graph with constructed robust embedded original-shore cores and the same additive degree error a.
